raw_excerpt: Anthropic: 'Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet' (Jun 21, 2024). Claude 3.5 Sonnet GA. 'We're also introducing Artifacts on Claude.ai, a new feature that expands how users can interact with Claude. When a user asks Claude to generate content like code snippets, text documents, or website designs, these Artifacts appear in a dedicated window alongside their conversation. This creates a dynamic workspace where they can see, edit, and build upon Claude's creations in real-time, seamlessly integrating AI-generated content into their projects and workflows. This preview feature marks Claude's evolution from a conversational AI to a collaborative work environment. It's just the beginning of a broader vision for Claude.ai, which will soon expand to support team collaboration.' Cost: $3/M input, $15/M output, 200K context. ASL-2 safety. Made generally available Aug 28, 2024.
